records.header: A) --- v ZO'N (07.24 p.m., November 10th); 17.50 3 TLE; 3 TL RICHI-98
source_rows: DDDVA DXVAX VAGDD DGADD DXDAG VVGAF AVGGA XDVVV
GAVGX XXXDV DDDAF XGVDG FXFXX ADDAX XXAVA XXDX
notes: The intact GAVGX group at the start of the second row was omitted by earlier OCR.

The printed 98-character indicator and explicit interruption support the declared 19-coordinate missing-tail model; this is a source model, not an assertion that every original coordinate was correctly copied.
The candidate fills only the first 33 ordinary-word positions. It retains the observed L after SENDEN and the entire received suffix.
An unconstrained one-gap screen has three zero-substitution fits, at gaps 77, 78, 79. All are retained separately; ordinary words alone do not prove the exact suffix geometry.

a3_gap_screen.geometry_selection: The primary gap 79 follows the printed interruption; the ordinary-word prefix alone ties gaps 77, 78, 79.
a3_gap_screen.mask: Only the first 33 letters are tested; all final 16 plaintext positions are masked.
